Type: core-hardening meta-epic
Work key: EP9
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Engineering lead accountable for cross-area integration
Scope: A coherent, bounded and recoverable repository core with evidence across organization/access, storage, recovery/lifecycle, performance, workflows and operation/upgrades.


Acceptance criteria:
1. H01-H06 independently review the six stated core promises using shared existing work plus the eight explicit engineering gaps.
2. H00 accepts a single candidate release after an integrated failure/upgrade/workflow rehearsal, not a collection of incompatible old receipts.
3. Engineering proceeds against local synthetic profiles without institutional prerequisites; later real-provider, alert/media/retention, human and operator acceptance remain explicit unchanged gates.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/EP9/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H01: bd-01M4X8M9386WG7Z2RW1J2C2RBB
- H02: bd-01M4X8M986VW0MMZ2S4AQDC58C
- H03: bd-01M4X8M9CTMTKZHBKG8T9E8EDS
- H04: bd-01M4X8M9GWYPFKAAZVHK760RSN
- H05: bd-01M4X8M9N0FV6ANAHVQ147KJNE
- H06: bd-01M4X8M9S1X431HCYR55D69QA5
- H00: bd-01M4X8M9WZPHVERYB9VPD23XD3

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: EP9: Harden the six repository core areas before the local demonstration
